question: Five friends P, B, C, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. B is sitting to the immediate left of C. G and H are not the immediate neighbour of C. H is sitting second to the right of P. Who is sitting on the immediate right of C?
solution:
Given: Five friends P, B, C, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre.

1) B is sitting to the immediate left of C.

2) G and H are not the immediate neighbour of C.

3) H is sitting second to the right of P.

Final arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9913d448c797936d9f46ed04de9962f32f8fcaae41a397da5bd54529a71f393b.png] 

So, **P** is sitting on the immediate right of C.

Hence, the correct answer is** "P".**
